```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

# Read in Data

locations <- read_csv("data/locations.csv")
visits <- read_csv("data/All National Parks Visitation 1904-2016.csv")
state_pop <- read_csv("data/state_pop.csv")
gas <- read_csv("data/gas_price.csv")
national_parks <- read_csv("data/national_parks.csv")

# Clean data and merge with state populations
vis_data_pop <- visits %>% 
  rename(visitors = Visitors,
         year = YearRaw,
         state = State,
         gnis_id = `Gnis Id`,
         park_name_display = `Unit Name`) %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(as.character(year)),
         gnis_id = as.character(gnis_id)) %>% 
  group_by(gnis_id, state, year, park_name_display) %>% 
  summarize(visitors = sum(visitors, na.rm = TRUE), .group = "drop") %>% 
  left_join(state_pop, by = c("state" = "state", "year" = "year")) %>% 
  rename(state_population = pop) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(state_population))

# Merge with Location
park_year_data <- locations %>% 
  mutate(gnis_id = as.character(gnis_id)) %>% 
  rename(lon = lon, lat = lat) %>% 
  right_join(vis_data_pop, by = "gnis_id") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) %>% 
  select(lon, lat, state, park_name_display, year, visitors, state_population)


# Create set of available years
years_available <- sort(as.numeric(unique(park_year_data$year)))

# Calculate max visitation for marker scaling 
max_visitors <- max(park_year_data$visitors, na.rm = TRUE)



# Ely Cleaned

park_visits <- read_csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2019/2019-09-17/national_parks.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Keep only National Parks with non-missing visitors
park_visits <- park_visits %>% 
  filter(unit_type == "National Park") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(visitors)) %>% 
  mutate(year_num = as.numeric(year))   

# IM region, years >= 2000 (no total rows)
im_parks <- park_visits %>% 
  filter(region == "IM",
         !is.na(year_num))

#grand total
im_total <- im_parks %>% 
  group_by(year_num) %>% 
  summarise(visitors = sum(visitors), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(unit_name = "Total Visitation")

im_parks <- bind_rows(im_parks, im_total)

# Vector of IM park names for the dropdown
im_park_list <- sort(unique(im_parks$unit_name))

```

### **About the Data**

This dashboard uses data from the **TidyTuesday National Parks Visitation dataset** (2019-09-17 release), which contains annual visitor counts to U.S. National Parks from 1904–2016. Additional data on state populations and entrance fees are included to enable regional and temporal comparisons.

### **Purpose of the Dashboard**

The dashboard allows users to explore:
- Total annual visitation trends over time  
- Differences in visitation by U.S. region  
- Park-level visitation trends across different eras  
- Interactive views of individual park visitation patterns  

### **How to Navigate**

Use:
- The **sidebar controls** to filter years or regions  
- The **interactive plots** (hover to see values)  
- Tabs and rows to explore different panels in the dashboard

### Park Visitors, State Pop and Gas Prices by year

```{r Leaflet map}
# Reactive expression to filter data based on slider input 
filtered_data <- reactive({
  req(input$year_select)
  park_year_data %>% 
    filter(year == input$year_select) %>% 
    distinct(lon, lat, .keep_all = TRUE)
})

# Leaflet map base layer 
renderLeaflet({
  leaflet() %>% 
    addTiles() %>% 
    setView(lng = -98.5, lat = 39.8, zoom = 3)
})

observe({
  data_to_plot <- filtered_data()
  
  data_to_plot <- data_to_plot %>% 
    mutate(
      radius = sqrt(visitors) / sqrt(max_visitors) * 20 + 3,
      popup_text = paste(
        "<b>", park_name_display, "</b><br>",
        "Year: ", year, "<br>",
        "Visitors: ", formatC(visitors, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0), "<br>",
        "State: ", state, "<br>",
        "State Population: ", formatC(state_population, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
      )
    )
  leafletProxy("Leafket map", data = data_to_plot) %>% 
    clearMarkers() %>% 
    addCircleMarkers(
      lng = ~lon,
      lat = ~lat,
      radius = ~radius,
      fillColor = "#0072B2", 
      color = "#000000",
      weight = 0.5, 
      opacity = 1, 
      fillOpacity = 0.8, 
      popup = ~popup_text
    )
})
```

### Visitors by year

```{r}
selectInput(
  inputId  = "park_choice",
  label    = "Choose a park:",
  choices  = im_park_list,
  selected = "Yellowstone National Park"
)
```

### Visitors by year

```{r}
renderPlot({
  req(input$park_choice)

  df <- im_parks %>% 
    filter(unit_name == input$park_choice)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = year_num, y = visitors)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Annual visitation –", input$park_choice),
      x = "Year",
      y = "Number of visitors"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
})
```
